name: time-field
description: A field for entering a time value.

segments.description: The segments of the field, in reading order. Each entry is drawn as one copy of the segment part. The request supplies them: the field does not build them from the granularity, the hour cycle or the locale. A placeholder segment shows its format text (for example hh) instead of a value, and a literal entry is a separator such as a colon.

label.description: The text drawn in the segment, or the separator when isLiteral is true.

isPlaceholder.description: Whether the segment is empty and shows its format text.

isLiteral.description: Whether the entry is a separator between segments, drawn as plain text without a segment cell.

isPlaceholder.description: Whether the rendered segment is empty and shows its format text. Per-segment in a data-driven component is segments[].isPlaceholder.

isLiteral.description: Whether the rendered entry is a separator. Per-segment in a data-driven component is segments[].isLiteral.

isError.description: Shows the field in its error state: the error icon appears at the end of the field.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the component: sets the width and the spacing between the label, the field and the help text.

anatomy.name: field-label
anatomy.description: Text label that names the field, placed above or beside it.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Bordered box that frames the segments.

anatomy.name: segment
anatomy.description: One editable piece of the time (hour, minute, period), drawn as its own rounded cell and showing a placeholder when empty. Repeated once per entry of the segments option.

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Text of a segment: its value, or its format text while the segment is empty (isPlaceholder). A separator entry (isLiteral) draws only this text.

anatomy.name: error-icon
anatomy.description: Alert icon in the end container of the field, shown when isError is true.

anatomy.name: help-text
anatomy.description: Description or error message shown below the field.

anatomy.name: focus-indicator
anatomy.description: Outline drawn around the field for keyboard focus.

anatomyReview.notes: Aligned to date-field (owner decisions D2 and A87, applied 2026-11-20): the bordered box was the container part and is now field, under a new root container. Figma S2 Web Date and time field page (shared with date-field); RSP TimeField. Options granularity, hourCycle and hideTimeZone use the RSP names; state set matches text-field. Literal separators are not a part.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The segments of the field. Each entry of the segments option is drawn as one copy of the segment part, in order, inside the field.
